content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To play pro basketball, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Attend an elite youth basketball camp (1 week)
Step 2. Hire a certified sports agent (3 days)
Step 3. Sign a multi-year professional contract (2 days)
Step 4. Participate in the NBA Summer League (2 weeks)
Step 5. Complete a team physical examination (4 hours)
Step 6. Attend the NBA Draft Combine (4 days)
Step 7. Hire a personal chef for nutrition (2 days)
Step 8. Conduct interviews with sports media (3 hours)
Step 9. Participate in preseason training camp (3 weeks)
Step 10. Film a national commercial for sneakers (1 day)
Step 11. Negotiate an endorsement deal (1 week)
Step 12. Secure a housing lease in the franchise city (5 days)
Step 13. Open a dedicated high-wealth savings account (2 hours)
Step 14. Undergo an MRI for baseline health (1 hour)
Step 15. Apply for an official player's license (10 days)
Step 16. Move into a temporary hotel near the arena (1 day)
Step 17. Submit official height and weight measurements (1 hour)
Step 18. Declare for the professional draft (15 minutes)
Step 19. Hire a professional financial advisor (4 hours)
Step 20. Meet with the team general manager (2 hours)
Step 21. Review the team's official playbook (5 days)
Step 22. Graduate from high school (4 years)
Step 23. Perform in individual team workouts (3 days)
Step 24. Receive your official team jersey (30 minutes)
Step 25. Play for a top-tier collegiate program (1 year)
Step 26. Get fitted for a custom travel suit (1 hour)
Step 27. Hire a specialized shooting coach (1 day)
Step 28. Practice high-intensity drills (1 month)
Step 29. Play for a international developmental league (6 months)
Step 30. Complete a collegiate career or equivalent (2 years)
Step 31. Review the final contract terms with a lawyer (5 hours)
Step 32. Obtain a high-limit disability insurance policy (1 week)
Step 33. Set up a local utility and internet account (2 hours)
Step 34. Find a reliable sports massage therapist (1 hour)
Step 35. Attend the NBA Draft lottery (1 day)
Step 36. Pass a mandatory league drug test (2 days)
Step 37. Receive an official draft selection (5 hours)
Step 38. Participate in the NBA Draft night (6 hours)
Step 39. Hire a strength and conditioning coach (3 days)
Step 40. Undergo a full cardiac screening (2 hours)
